display.purpose: Brand moments only: landing hero in the Gold variant, og share cards, the share-card export. Never for article body.

headline.purpose: Article h1 on marketing pages. Information first, ornament never.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color shifts on links and controls. The only motion on marketing pages.

breakpoints.name: calc-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Calculator grid drops from 2 columns to 1.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single gold CTA — demo or pricing, never both styles at once.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-block; background:#c9a227; color:#12140f; font:600 16px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:11px 20px; border-radius:8px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#e0bf58; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e9c84a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-block; background:transparent; color:#e9ecf1; border:1px solid #232a36; font:600 16px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; padding:11px 20px; border-radius:8px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#c9a227; color:#c9a227; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e9c84a; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: CTA panel and calculator panel: flat surface, hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#141822; border:1px solid #232a36; border-radius:12px; padding:22px; color:#e9ecf1; font:400 16px/1.65 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:1.06rem; } .ds-card p { color:#cdd4e0; margin:0 0 10px; }

components.name: Callout
components.description: The honesty box (‘One honest thing’, ‘Fair comparison’): gold-tinted panel, no border-left.
components.html: One honest thing: the kill switch is a warning, not an execution tool.
components.css: .ds-callout { background:rgba(201,162,39,0.07); border-radius:8px; padding:12px 16px; margin:16px 0; color:#e9ecf1; font:400 16px/1.65 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Calculator fields: canvas-dark field on card surface.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:#0d0f14; border:1px solid #232a36; border-radius:8px; color:#e9ecf1; padding:10px 12px; font:400 16px/1.5 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline:1px solid #c9a227; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Risk preset pills in the calculator.
components.css: .ds-chip { background:transparent; border:1px solid #232a36; border-radius:999px; color:#9aa3b2; padding:5px 14px; font:400 0.9rem Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color:#e9ecf1; } .ds-chip.ds-on { border-color:#c9a227; color:#c9a227; }

components.name: Top Nav
components.description: Brand left, quiet links right, hairline rule below.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid #232a36; padding-bottom:14px; margin-bottom:34px; font:400 14px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav b { margin-right:auto; letter-spacing:0.02em; color:#e9ecf1; } .ds-nav a { color:#9aa3b2; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#e9ecf1; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset:2px; border-radius:2px; }

narrative.overview: The Gold Plan's public surface is a dark editorial ledger: a near-black canvas, hairline rules, one scarce gold accent, and typography that reads like a well-kept trading journal. Every page argues discipline, not profit; the design carries that by being quiet, exact, and unhurried. Decoration that the discipline story cannot justify does not ship.
keyCharacteristics: Dark blueprint-black canvas (#0d0f14) with hairline slate borders — depth comes from surface steps, never shadows.
One scarce gold accent (#c9a227) for links, key numbers, and the single primary CTA.
Playfair Display for brand moments (landing hero, share cards); Inter for working type; JetBrains Mono for numbers.
Single 65–75ch reading column; marketing pages are articles, not dashboards.
Flat by default: no drop shadows, no gradients, no glass.

rules.name: The Scarce Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on links, one or two key numbers, and one primary CTA per view — under 10% of any screen. When everything is gold, nothing is.

rules.name: The Ledger Voice Rule
rules.body: Headlines state facts in the product's own language ('Prop firm daily loss tracker for gold traders'), never marketing abstractions.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat with 1px hairline borders. Depth is surface color steps, not shadows.

dos: Do keep body copy at 16px/1.65 in the 720px column (65–75ch).
Do give headings more space above than below (h2: 38px above, 10px below).
Do use gold-tinted panels (rgba(201,162,39,0.07)) for callouts instead of border-left bars.
Do keep one primary CTA per view; everything else is ghost.
donts: Don't use gold as a section background or card fill.
Don't add eyebrows/kickers above headings — the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use border-left/border-right bars above 1px on callouts and cards.
Don't introduce a second chromatic accent; semantic green/red only for P&L values.
Don't ship drop shadows, gradients, or glass on the marketing canvas.
